# Bengaluru Sreehatta Sammelani (BSS)
Official website: https://bssbangalore.com/
Guides and stories: https://bssbangalore.com/stories.html

BSS is a socio-cultural association bringing together Sylhetis and friends of the community in Bengaluru.

## BSS Durga Puja 2026
Dates: 16–21 October 2026
Venue: The Occasion, Hoodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048

## Confirmed visitor facts
BSS welcomes everyone, not only Bengalis or Sylhetis.
The Occasion address: Sri Devi Anugraha, Anup Layout, Basi Reddy Garden, KR Puram Road, Hoodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048.
Bhog is served from 1:30 PM to 3:30 PM every Puja day from 16 to 21 October 2026.
Parking capacity, entry fees and travel times are not currently confirmed on the official BSS site.

## Confirmed schedule summary
16 October 2026: Maha Shasthi; Pushpanjali 9:30 AM.
17 October 2026: Maha Saptami; Pushpanjali 11:00 AM; Ochin Pakhi live band 8:00 PM.
18 October 2026: Ashtami programme day; Pushpanjali 11:00 AM; DJ & Dandiya 7:30 PM.
19 October 2026: Ashtami programme day; Sandhi Puja 7:26 AM; Pushpanjali 11:00 AM; Dhunuchi Competition 7:30 PM.
20 October 2026: Maha Navami; Navami Puja 6:00 AM; Navami Yagya 7:30 AM; Pushpanjali 11:00 AM; Dhamail of Unity 12:00 PM; Dandiya 7:30 PM.
21 October 2026: Bijoya Dashami; Dashami Puja 6:00 AM; Sindhur Khela 10:30 AM; Bhog 1:30–3:30 PM; Shanti Jol 7:00 PM.
The published BSS programme confirms the Sindhur Khela time but does not specify participation rules.

The schedule labels 18 and 19 October as two Ashtami programme days, following the programme shared by the BSS organising team.
